description: Work Zone Data Feed Registry is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by United States Department of Transportation (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) --- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office. (2020). Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx) Feed Registry. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1518702". This dataset contains the up-to-date metadata on Work Zone feeds that meet the Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx) specification or Connected Work Zone (CWZ) Standard and are registered with USDOT ITS DataHub. The current work zone data from each feed can be accessed through their respective API links. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 16 columns, among them url, apiKeyURL, US Counties, US States, United States, StateCoordinate. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last data update. Attribution given: United States Department of Transportation (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
